technician repeated own-session restriction, scoped reads and finance/readiness denials
all nine original incidents retained and independently searched in audit history

gates.name: Reviewed release scope
gates.evidence: Owner-approved release scope and reviewed source baseline are required.

gates.name: Web build and CI
gates.evidence: Run the documented build against the reviewed release revision; source code alone does not prove this deployment.

gates.name: Native distribution
gates.evidence: Hermes exports are available; signed device builds, identifiers, permissions and store approval require verification.

gates.name: Managed database and TLS
gates.evidence: A connection is configured; restricted identity, advisors, TLS and staging acceptance still require evidence.

gates.name: Production origin
gates.evidence: A verified HTTPS origin, certificate and hosting configuration are required.

gates.name: Independent business authority
gates.evidence: 6 active Admin/business owner account(s), 6 active Inventory/finance account(s). One business owner is supported. Restricted actions still require distinct eligible reviewers; verify maker, reviewer and executor responsibilities for the actual staff and branches.

gates.name: Reviewed customer policies
gates.evidence: 9 of 9 policies published and effective; legal/business review and acceptance evidence remain necessary.

gates.name: Physical inventory
gates.evidence: 4 published stocked lines; reconcile physical counts and serial eligibility before sale.

gates.name: Qualified service operation
gates.evidence: 5 active services with approved checklist; verify actual qualifications, areas, equipment and field processes.

gates.name: Online payments
gates.evidence: The configured gateway is enabled for sandbox/test payments only. Live merchant ownership, provider acceptance and commercial release remain unverified.

gates.name: Cash and credit reconciliation
gates.evidence: Finance must verify counted cash, liability balances and refund controls against real records.

gates.name: Notification providers
gates.evidence: Transactional SMTP adapter exists behind an OFF flag. Verified sender, real recovery delivery, provider monitoring and outage acceptance remain required. In-app notifications are persisted.

gates.name: Authentication and security
gates.evidence: Local tests cover sessions, ownership and role/branch controls. Independent assessment, abuse/load testing and native toolchain advisories remain.

gates.name: Multi-connection concurrency
gates.evidence: Isolated PostgreSQL concurrency and uncertain-COMMIT tests passed. Run against the reviewed deployment revision and capacity before release.

gates.name: Backups and restore
gates.evidence: Encrypted local restore tests pass; managed/off-site backups, retention, recovery objectives and production restore drill are required.

gates.name: Monitoring and incidents
gates.evidence: 9 unresolved high/critical incidents. External health/error alerting and on-call ownership must be configured.

gates.name: Workers and recovery
gates.evidence: Worker heartbeat missing/stale or schema incomplete. Configure and supervise the worker before serving traffic.

gates.name: Privacy and retention
gates.evidence: Owned export and request intake exist. Verified erasure/retention and incident fulfilment processes remain incomplete.

gates.name: Acceptance and authorisation
gates.evidence: Business, finance, qualified safety reviewers and operations must accept their scope; production release requires explicit user authorisation.
